messages:
Hannah Li: quick flag - after turning on tenant-priority routing in canary we saw some requests for tenant `papertrail` with quota project set to `-` in billing logs. pinging eng-platform.
Marco Diaz: noted. timeline shows feature flip at 09:07 and the anomalies start at 09:09. looks like proxy routes earlier than quota lookup.
Priya Patel: PR changed the proxy to attach `x-tenant-pool` to improve batching. we assumed quota would still use original claims. clearly that's not true.
June: mitigation: toggled routing.fallback.papertrail = true via console to force global routing for that tenant. rollout-bot applied the flag.
rollout-bot: feature flag applied routing.fallback.papertrail = ON (run id ff-9057)
Hannah Li: short-term runbook note: if project attribution diverges, enable per-tenant fallback and notify billing.
Marco Diaz: long-term fix: proxy should forward `x-original-project` to quota service and quota must prefer it if present. lower risk than reordering auth flow.
Priya Patel: I'll add `auth.routing.decision` to token logs for correlation and prototype the header passthrough in staging today. want a small canary tomorrow.
June: also adding a dashboard card: "routing decision vs quota project" with per-tenant filter. alert: page eng-platform if any tenant >1% requests with project=unknown for >3m after routing change.
Hannah Li: thanks team. I'll notify Papertrail ops about temporary fallback and next steps.
